theory.md: Просьбы и приказы пересказывают через **tell / ask + кого + to + глагол**: «Wait here!» → He **told me to wait** there. «Please help me» → She **asked me to help** her. Отрицание — **not to**: He told me **not to** go.

cells: She told me to sit down.
He asked me to close the door.
The guardian told me not to lie.

theory.md: «He said me to wait» — ошибка: после say нет человека и to-конструкции. Нужно told me to wait.

examples.es: The guard told us to wait on the platform.
examples.ru: Кондуктор велел нам ждать на платформе.

examples.es: Molly asked me to find her brother.
examples.ru: Молли попросила меня найти её брата.

examples.es: The doctor told him not to walk.
She asked us not to make a noise.

options: He told me to take water.
He said me to take water.
